sentences.text:
And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- S.K. Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.
1.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C/528 B.N.S.S has been preferred with a prayer to
quash the order dated 31.01.2025, passed by the Additional District and Sessions Judge/FTC-III,
Raebareli in S.T No. 199 of 2019, Crime No. 09 of 2019, under Sections 376 D, 506, 507 I.P.C and
Section 67 I.T Act, P.S Mahila Thana, District Raebareli and allow the application of the applicant
dated 20.01.2025.
2.

Learned A.G.A has raised a preliminary objection regarding the maintainability of the present
application on the ground that the applicant has a statutory remedy to file a revision under Section
397 read with Section 401 Cr.P.C against the rejection of the application under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
Sarvesh Singh @ Ghasi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ... on 8 April, 2025

3.

sentences.text: After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant may be permitted to withdraw the present application as dismissed as not pressed with liberty to file a revision.
4. As such, the present application is dismissed as not pressed with liberty to avail the remedy as may be permissible under the law.
